items.title: Navy Rallies to Stun No. 24 Memphis 38-34 on Listorti's Last-Second Touchdown
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. — Senior running back Vic Listorti scored on a 6-yard touchdown run on fourth-and-1 with 15 seconds remaining and junior quarterback Jackson Gutierrez rushed for a career-high 241 yards and two touchdowns as Navy rallied from a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit to stun No. 24 Memphis 38-34 on Senior Day Saturday afternoon before 29,080 at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial

items.title: The Rivalry Returns: Philadelphia Awarded Four Future Army-Navy Game Matchups
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – The Philadelphia Convention and Visitors Bureau (PHLCVB), together with the Army Athletic Association and Naval Academy Athletic Association representatives and city and state leaders, announced the return of the Army-Navy Game presented by USAA to Philadelphia for four additional years.

items.title: Navy and Memphis to Square Off in Home Finale
items.summary: Navy (3-6, 2-4 American Conference) and RV Memphis (8-2, 5-1) will meet on the gridiron for the 12th time in series history when the two square off on ESPN2 on Saturday (12 noon) at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium (34,000), America's finest and most patriotic stadium, in Annapolis. Saturday's contest is Senior Day and the game is presented by First Command.

items.title: Navy Athletics and Under Armour Unveil 2026 Army-Navy Uniform Honoring Naval Special Warfare
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. — Navy Athletics and Under Armour unveiled the 2026 Army-Navy football uniform, honoring the extraordinary history, heritage and sacrifice of the men and women of Naval Special Warfare (NSW), including the Navy SEALs, Special Warfare Combatant-Craft Crewmen (SWCC) and the pioneering Underwater Demolition Teams (UDT) that laid the foundation for modern Naval Special Warfare.

items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas (Nov. 10, 2026) — The Davey O'Brien Foundation unveiled the Davey O'Brien QB Class of 2026 today, a group that includes 30 players from across the nation who are now officially in contention for the 2026 Davey O'Brien National Quarterback Award.
